p: "He made the letter Tes king over hearing," and so on,
and the left kidney in the person."

that the holiness of this month
is the Name that emerges from the combination
one should have in mind the Name Havayah

one then merits the holiness of the month,
and so too one then says the Kedushah of "Keser,"
at which it is the time
to merit holiness at its root,

is that it should enter the heart,
and not only that it enter the ear
that takes in at one end and lets out at the other;
"Above all that you guard, guard your heart,
for from it are the sources of life."
And this month is the time
to merit that it enter the heart,
and that they merit for it to be as dear to a person
as on the day the Torah was given,
that is, to rectify every blemish
and the damage of the serpent,
so that all words of Torah will be
only from the side of the Tree of Life.
וּבָא הָאוֹת י׳ בְּרֹאשׁ תֵּיבַת יִשְׂרָאֵל,
And the letter Yud comes at the head of the word "Yisrael";
on account of "For you have striven
with Elokim and with men, and you have prevailed"
This is based on what is stated
that breaks the yetzer hara except Torah";
and this means Torah she'b'al peh
And as for what it says,
"and the left kidney in the person" —
עַל פִּי מַה שֶּׁאָמְרוּ (בְּרָכוֹת סא, א)
it is based on what is stated (Berachos 61a):
that the good one is on his right and the bad one on his left,"
and "the heart of a fool is to his left"
so why was the left one created,
why did He create the yetzer hara," and so on —
"The Holy One, blessed be He, said:
You are the one who makes it evil," and so on.
For Hashem Yisbarach created in man
and created the heart of the fool
in order to empty the evil out of it,
his inclination and desire toward words of Torah,
and then it too will be good.
For the essential root of words of Torah
that words of Torah enter the heart of the wise;
to uproot the evil from the heart of the fool.
and likewise, "whoever engages in Torah for its own sake —
people benefit from him counsel and sound wisdom," and so on
הַיְינוּ גַּם כֵּן עֵצָה בְּדִבְרֵי תּוֹרָה
this too means counsel in words of Torah:
such that words of Torah enter the heart,
so that one can uproot the evil from the heart of the fool.
וְהַיְינוּ עַל יְדֵי אוֹר תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה
And this is through the light of Torah she'b'al peh,
for which this month is designated.
as referring to words of Torah,
and that means Torah she'b'al peh,
שֶׁבָּא רַק עַל יְדֵי עָמָל וִיגִיעָה
which comes only through toil and effort,
and it weakens a person's strength,
in that the power of the yetzer hara is broken,
and one merits to empty out the evil
from the heart of the fool as well.
שֶׁכֵּן מוֹרֶה מַאֲמַר לֹא יִהְיֶה לְךָ
For this is what the utterance "Lo yihyeh lecha" indicates:
to bring fear into the heart,
is the root of the positive commandments,
is the root of the negative commandments,
And fear of such a kind
that it is as if the Holy One, blessed be He,
זֶהוּ רַק עַל יְדֵי דִּבְרֵי תוֹרָה,
this comes only through words of Torah,
through hearing of such a kind
that the words of Torah enter,
"… in Your Torah" — a word is missing in the text —
And this is why it says
"and the left kidney in the person."
be silent (has), and afterward analyze (katteis)," and so on;
That is, the essential holiness of this month:
first one should see to it
that he not go about idle
to reflect deeply on the Torah
so that the words of Torah enter the heart;
and through this he will merit the combination
as on the day it was given from Har Sinai,
only from the Tree of Life,
and they would not taste at all
and this is why it says
"and the left kidney in the person."
